items.q: Do I need any special hardware for QR Zaman?
items.a: No. Just print the QR code you generate in the panel and put it on the wall. Employees scan it with the QR Zaman app on their own phones.

items.q: Can an employee clock in for someone else?
items.a: No. Each account is bound to a single device, the phone's location is captured at the moment of scanning, and fake location apps are detected.

items.q: Is payroll calculated according to current regulations?
items.a: Tax brackets, social security rates, minimum wage exemptions, severance and notice rules and public holidays are kept per year and copied to the new year in one click.

items.q: Can I manage more than one company and branch?
items.a: Yes. QR Zaman works with a group, company, branch and department hierarchy, and every user gets their own access scope.

items.q: How do I import my existing employee list?
items.a: Download the ready Excel template, fill it in and import it in one go; you get a result report for every row.
